messages:
Jordan: Escalating from Support -> CS: trial account Vectra seeing recurring 502s for embeddings starting ~03:10 PDT. Support restarted pods; still intermittent. Need CS comms + enablement plan.
Priya: Acknowledged. Can you paste a sample error and last success time?
Jordan: Last success at 03:09. Failing at 03:12. Sample log:
```ERROR embed-service: upstream 502 model=embed-mini-v2 trace=tx-77f4 err=\"upstream timeout (kv cache)\"```
Jordan: Repro: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-mini-v2","input":"hi"}' -> 502 from prod-us-west-1 pool. INF-2104 created.
ops-bot: [alert] embed-service 5xx spike (prod-us-west-1) — 64 errors in 5m.
Priya: Lee, can you help with ops playbook and a short note to send to the customer? Noah FYI on renewal posture (trial ends in 3 days).
Lee: On it. Ops checklist: 1) temp route to fallback-pool 2) bump KV cache TTL to 20s for tenant Vectra 3) turn on verbose traces for trace ids 77f4* for 45m 4) watch error-rate and p50 latency on dashboard https://console.redwood.ai/dash/prod-us-west-1
Jordan: Support can switch routing now if CS approves customer-facing notice.
Noah: If impact >4h mark as renewal-watch and offer a prioritized enablement slot. Also prep discount/credit guidance for commercialization conversation.
Priya: Draft ack to customer (short): "Hi Vectra team — were investigating intermittent 502 errors affecting embeddings in your trial. Weve applied a mitigation (routing to fallback capacity) and will update within 60 minutes. Apologies for the disruption; well follow up with an RCA and optional enablement session. — Priya, Customer Success"
Lee: Executed fallback routing at 3611112230. Initial checks: 14/15 requests successful, one transient 502. Verbose traces enabled.
ops-bot: [incident-update] INF-2104 mitigation applied (fallback routing) at 3611112230.
Priya: Sent acknowledgement to Vectra at 3611112233 and copied message to thread.
Lee: Monitoring: error rate down to 1.2% over last 10m. Keep verbose traces for full 45m. If it climbs above 5% escalate to runtime-eng.
Jordan: Scheduling a 20-min sync with customer + SE to discuss impact and next steps. Proposed time: 11:45 PDT (in 35m).
Noah: I'll tag the account in CRM as "renewal-watch" and create follow-up tasks: postmortem + enablement invite + credit review if SLA breached.
Priya: Action owners: Jordan (monitor & customer updates), Lee (ops mitigation & logs), Noah (CRM + renewal play), Priya (comm + schedule meeting).
Lee: If customer accepts enablement session, include a quick run-through of embed sizing, KV cache best practices, and retry/backoff guidance.
Jordan: Error rate stable at 0.6% last 15m. Will close thread when <0.5% for 30m. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
